answer: A sybil defense is bonded proof-of-work identity: new agents burn compute and lock collateral before transacting, and bonds scale with each vouched identity. Rewards flow only along the attestation graph, so a farmer of many clones reaches a nadir of profit: each fake agent costs electricity, ferrous-hardware rental and locked capital, while honest peers attest only verifiable work. Vouching for fraud slashes the voucher's bond, making collusion costly. This layer acts as a yarrow filter, screening cheap sprouts before they reach the ledger, so sybils must spend real resources per identity.
